name: Rufflet
description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the target.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user.
